Select Sum(AA.InSumAmt) as InSumAmt, Sum(AA.InAmt) As InAmt, Sum(AA.InTAmt) As InTAmt, Sum(AA.OutSumAmt) as OutSumAmt, Sum(AA.OutAmt) As OutAmt, Sum(AA.OutTAmt) As OutTAmt,
Sum(AA.BefAmt) As BefAmt,
Sum(AA.BefAmt +AA.InAmt - AA.OutAmt) As BefAmt,
Sum(AA.BefAmt +AA.InAmt - AA.OutAmt + AA.InTAmt - AA.OutTAmt) As TotAmt From ( Select Sum(금액) as InSumAmt, Sum(IIF(날짜 < #{date},금액,0 )) As InAmt, Sum(IIF(날짜 = #{date},금액,0 )) As InTAmt, 0 as OutSumAmt, 0 As OutAmt, 0 As OutTAmt, 0 As BefAmt from 수입 Where 년도 = #{year} And 코드분류 = #{codeGb} UNION ALL Select 0 as InSumAmt, 0 As InAmt, 0 As InTAmt, Sum(금액) as OutSumAmt, Sum(IIF(날짜 < #{date},금액,0 )) As OutAmt, Sum(IIF(날짜 = #{date},금액,0 )) As OutTAmt, 0 As BefAmt from 지출 Where 년도 = #{year} And 코드분류 = #{codeGb} UNION ALL Select 0 as InSumAmt, 0 As InAmt, 0 As InTAmt, 0 as OutSumAmt, 0 As OutAmt, 0 As OutTAmt, sum(이월금) As BefAmt from 환경 Where 년도 = #{year} And 코드분류 = #{codeGb} ) AA
